control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT is below 60 %, check the line tracker (below 90 %: curve left 15/35; above 95 %: curve right 35/15; else avoidWalls); else avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, check the obstacle sensors (left: turn right 20 degrees; right: turn left 20 degrees; else driveInTheDark); else driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left 10/40; else curve right 40/10.
